products.title: squansh club // guts // 3 quarter sleeve
products.body_html:
This design appropriates a frame from p.198 of the Berserk Manga by Kentaro Miura. Guts' sword has been replaced with a squash racquet, flexing under the stress of the immense power with which he has smashed the squash ball out through the edge of the frame.

products.title: soft serve tennis club // spooky colours // t-shirt
products.body_html:
Soft Serve Tennis Club was the design that started this venture.
Originally created as a Christmas present for a group of friends that played tennis at the Wick Park tennis courts weekly, I wanted a way to be able to print these off whenever I required one.
The design adapts the logo of an Australian soft serve company to humourous effect.
This is the spooky colour variation of the original. We all love a little bit of spook.
_____

The standard in premium unisex t-shirts. A well-loved favorite, featuring a crew neck, short sleeves and designed with superior combed and ring-spun cotton that acts as the best blank canvas for printing.

General A top-choice garment known for its softness, durability, and compatibility with DTG printing, making it a favorite in both retail and promotional markets

products.title: troglodyte99 // flesh ghost logo // hoodie
products.body_html:
This Troglodyte99 hoodie features the Flesh Ghost mascot, designed for the release of the group's premiere single, 'Flesh is My Colour'.
Flesh Ghost is a sort of nonsensical but resonant concept that the Trog99 wanted to represent them. Another iteration of the concept can seen used as their single art on Spotify.

#ghost #music #undergroundhiphop #hoodie #troglodyte

products.title: VERY NICE // Fresh fruit // Limited edition hoodie
products.body_html:
This print is inspired by a favourite hoodie of mine from the early 2000s skateboard culture boom. The merch is no longer available, so I replicated and reimagined the logo and print as a homage to that hype era, bringing the colours and tones up a notch.
The eyes of the brand’s original monster mascot/motif have been moved into the mouth, giving us the impression that the monster is now being worn as a suit.

#skate #2000s #toymachine #hoodie
